name: Tallyman
description: Generic Tally enforcer: grey pressure armour, shock baton, restraint loops, and a reader. Carries nothing lethal, because a body is not a line on a manifest.
narrative:
Spawn these in twos and threes. They detain, they fine, they impound, and they
do not kill -- not from mercy but from bookkeeping, and they will say so.
equipment: Tally pressure armour, grey (AP 4 all locations)
actor_notes: Never arm these with anything lethal. They fight to restrain: expect Trip, Grip and Stun Location rather than Impale. A tallyman who has restrained you has WON, and the scene continues from a cell.
